content.text:
<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Summarise the quarterly report above in three sentences. Each sentence names
one or two regions. Each sentence relates its figures to another figure or
to the total, by comparison, ranking, difference, or contribution to the
total.

Reproduce every revenue figure exactly as the report states it. Do not
round, convert or restate a figure in different units.

response.text: North America led all four regions with 41.2 million, accounting for nearly half of the 87.4 million total. EMEA ranked second at 28.7 million, well ahead of Japan, which placed third with 11.4 million. Australia recorded the smallest figure at 6.1 million, contributing the least to the 87.4 million total.
